notes: 6.8.1: a custom language now works in the glossary — adding one also adds its column to every existing glossary (padding the rows) and to new ones, so a term in it is actually found during translation instead of the glossary silently not applying. Deleting a history record now deletes its proofread data too: the two lived in separate stores, so a deleted record used to leave a proofread entry behind with no way to remove it from the UI. / 6.8.1：自定义语言现在在词汇表里也能用——添加语言会给所有已有词汇表（含 Default）和新建词汇表补上该列并补齐每行，术语真的能在翻译时命中，不再静默失效。删除历史记录时会一并删除对应的校对记录：两者原本分开存储，删了历史后校对页那一条会永远留着且界面上无法删除。
